exposure: Administration of terbutaline prior to emergency caesarean section
cohort: Women who underwent a category one or two caesarean section between February 2018 and June 2019
finding: Implementing a policy recommending terbutaline administration before category one and two caesarean sections did not improve arterial cord pH but was associated with higher arterial cord lactate and maternal heart rate.
mod_finding: A policy recommending terbutaline administration prior to emergency caesarean section did not improve arterial cord pH.
